design: Each18 group gets its own training eigenbasis; evaluate same-group validation capture. Compute validation eigenspectrum as explicitly in-sample optimistic rank bound, not transferable predictor. Compare shared H304 basis. Same saved moments, no new model execution.

gates.specialist32: all groups >=80% validation capture with own train rank32
gates.specialist128: all groups >=80% validation capture with own train rank128
gates.specialization_gain32: equal-group mean specialist minus shared at rank32 >=10pp
gates.oracle128: all groups rank128 in-sample validation bound>=80%
